name: skills
title_zh: 工程师手边那几把顺手的螺丝刀
tagline_zh: 不是大而全的技能市场，是一个人自己天天用、用顺手了才留下的几件：写代码、查资料、理思路，各管一段，装完不用再挑。
tagline_en: Not a sprawling skill marketplace — just the few its author actually reaches for daily: code, research, thinking.
why_zh: 作者自用沉淀，件数少所以每件都被真事磨过；不追求覆盖全流程，只补最常卡手的那几步。
why_en: Distilled from the author's own daily use, so every piece has been worn smooth by real work — it patches the steps that snag.
limit_zh: 是个人自用合集，没有统一文档和版本承诺，件数随作者心情增删；只覆盖他本人工作流里的那几格。
limit_en: A personal collection: no unified docs or version promises, items come and go, and it only covers the author's own workflow — other stacks need edits.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: A handful of well-worn screwdrivers for engineers
